answer: What survives to the nectar is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reduced by each unverified claim, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Every claim climbs the plume of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the walnut re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
